method: Reverse-DCF: 10yr explicit FCF at 10% discount, 2.5% terminal growth; solve the FCF growth rate the current price implies (bisection). Compare 'implied' to plausible consensus growth. Excludes pre-revenue/negative-FCF/story names (Oklo, NuScale, IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, CoreWeave, Nebius, AST, Hertz) and banks/insurers (GS, JPM, UNH) where reverse-DCF is not meaningful. TSM excluded (ADR/ordinary-share mismatch); MELI excluded (fintech float distorts FCF).
